source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-13: All That Glitters

items.name: Motion Sense
items.text: An amalgam ooze can feel nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

items.name: Body Spout
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The amalgam ooze spews liquid from its body at a creature, roll 1d6 to determine the effect using the table below. Each is resisted with a successful DC 16 basic Reflex save save:

1: 1d6+2 acid damage

2–3: 1d6 cold damage

4–5: 1d6 fire damage

6: restore 1d6 healing hit points

items.name: Dazzling Surface
items.text:
Requirements The amalgam ooze is targeted by an attack

---
Effect The multicolored surface of the amalgam ooze shifts rapidly. The attacking creature is Dazzled and Off-Guard until the start of its next turn unless it succeeds at a DC 18 Will save save.
